name: Western Ridge Resources Limited
summary: Western Ridge Resources Limited, an Australian company established in 2021 and based in Peppermint Grove, identifies, acquires and advances battery and critical mineral projects in Brazil, Canada and Australia, targeting niobium, tantalum, rare earths, uranium and lithium pegmatites. Its key holdings are two niobium projects, Equador and Juazerinho, in northeastern Brazil's Borborema Pegmatitic Province.
